title: API memory limit too low
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API container, the memory‑limit/OOM problem, and the trigger of the reduced memory limit.
option_titles: Restore api memory limit to previous 512 MiB
Increase api memory limit to 1024 MiB for larger buffer
root_cause: The API container's memory limit was reduced from 512 MiB to 150 MiB 30 minutes ago, which is insufficient for the application's startup memory needs, causing the Linux OOM killer to terminate the container immediately after start (exit code 137).
truth: Someone lowered the api container's memory limit from 512MiB to 150MiB, below its normal working set of ~180MiB, so the kernel OOM killer repeatedly terminates it (exit code 137).
check_first: API container logs and Docker restart count
